A new comic that I commissioned from Astraea-R on DeviantArt. More pages will be added as they're created. Visuals made by Astraea-R with the story being written by me.

artist's page: https://www.deviantart.com/astraea-r

Please feel free to leave comments and let us know what you think of the story, or even offer some suggestions.

**This is a private commission from Astraea-R. It will only be posted here on e-hentai and he works on it when he can. So, please don’t bombard him with questions about when/where this series will be updated on his DeviantArt page or his Patreon. I check this page regularly, so if you have any questions please comment them down below and refrain from messaging Astraea directly, I'll answer any questions I can**
